title: ISS fire response, used as the conservative default
note: Each line is a verbatim sentence of NTRS 20220019247, section 3.2. The action text is VESTA's short label for it. Every line goes through the quote gate and ships as a finding PROT-nn (pillar response, work operations, read in a NASA report).

lines.action: Raise the alarm. Any crew member may.
lines.limit: ISS procedure for low Earth orbit, with ground support and a return vehicle. Applied here as the conservative default; not validated for this vehicle.

source.title: Evolution of Hardware and Philosophy of Emergency Response Actions on the International Space Station and Future Spacecrafts
source.quote: The crew may also initiate the alarm if they see or smell evidence of a combustion event.

lines.action: Gather at a clean point and keep measuring the air.
lines.limit: ISS procedure for low Earth orbit, with ground support and a return vehicle. Applied here as the conservative default; not validated for this vehicle.

source.title: Evolution of Hardware and Philosophy of Emergency Response Actions on the International Space Station and Future Spacecrafts
source.quote: They will constantly monitor air quality using hand-held combustion product analyzers to ensure their gathering point remains a safe haven with a clean atmosphere.

lines.action: Fans, gas introduction and oxygen generation stay off.
lines.limit: ISS procedure for low Earth orbit, with ground support and a return vehicle. Applied here as the conservative default; not validated for this vehicle.

source.title: Evolution of Hardware and Philosophy of Emergency Response Actions on the International Space Station and Future Spacecrafts
source.quote: Intramodular and intermodular fans are deactivated, gas introduction is terminated, oxygen generation systems are deactivated, and location specific fans are deactivated

lines.action: Remove power at the alarm location.
lines.limit: ISS procedure for low Earth orbit, with ground support and a return vehicle. Applied here as the conservative default; not validated for this vehicle.

source.title: Evolution of Hardware and Philosophy of Emergency Response Actions on the International Space Station and Future Spacecrafts
source.quote: If a location specific fire alarm is triggered, then power in that area is removed.

lines.action: Put on breathing masks before investigating; use the combustion-product analyzer to locate the event.
lines.limit: ISS procedure for low Earth orbit, with ground support and a return vehicle. Applied here as the conservative default; not validated for this vehicle.

source.title: Evolution of Hardware and Philosophy of Emergency Response Actions on the International Space Station and Future Spacecrafts
source.quote: Upon identifying the locations to investigate, crew will don breathing masks, to be described in section 3.2.4. Utilizing their combustion product analyzer and probe (section 3.2.5) to identify the location of the event, crew will proceed to unpower the equipment behind the panel, thus attacking the Ignition Source (Heat) leg of the fire triangle.

lines.action: Unpower the equipment behind the panel.
lines.limit: ISS procedure for low Earth orbit, with ground support and a return vehicle. Applied here as the conservative default; not validated for this vehicle.

source.title: Evolution of Hardware and Philosophy of Emergency Response Actions on the International Space Station and Future Spacecrafts
source.quote: crew will proceed to unpower the equipment behind the panel, thus attacking the Ignition Source (Heat) leg of the fire triangle.

lines.action: Use the extinguisher if unpowering fails.
lines.limit: ISS procedure for low Earth orbit, with ground support and a return vehicle. Applied here as the conservative default; not validated for this vehicle.

source.title: Evolution of Hardware and Philosophy of Emergency Response Actions on the International Space Station and Future Spacecrafts
source.quote: If that does not extinguish the fire, they will utilize a fire extinguisher

lines.action: Partial, then full powerdown; leave the module.
lines.limit: ISS procedure for low Earth orbit, with ground support and a return vehicle. Applied here as the conservative default; not validated for this vehicle.

source.title: Evolution of Hardware and Philosophy of Emergency Response Actions on the International Space Station and Future Spacecrafts
source.quote: If the fire extinguisher fails to stop the event, crew will proceed to a partial powerdown of the entire module they are located in, followed by a full powerdown and evacuation of the module.

lines.action: If the crew feels uncomfortable continuing, they may choose to isolate an isolatable module and stop further response.
lines.limit: ISS procedure for low Earth orbit, with ground support and a return vehicle. Isolation requires an isolatable module. A material evidence gap alone is not an instruction to isolate. Applied here as the conservative default; not validated for this vehicle.

source.title: Evolution of Hardware and Philosophy of Emergency Response Actions on the International Space Station and Future Spacecrafts
source.quote: It should be noted, with crew safety being the top priority, if at any point crew does not feel comfortable proceeding forward through the procedures, it is their prerogative to isolate the module and stand down on any further fire response steps.
